summary: Phase 149O.1H.2 -- HATP Proof Models + Canonical Serialization Independent Re-Verification: independent adversarial re-verification of the 149O.1H.1 repair of B-149O.1H-1 and B-149O.1H-2 against src/pcae/core/human_approval_trusted_provenance.py (Wave 3), trusting neither the 149O.1H.1 repair report, the 149O.1H.1R evidence analysis, nor the 149O.1R report-trust outcome as substitutes for fresh verification. Reconstructed the exact production repair diff between the pre-repair commit 01c7fb74 (149O.1G) and the repair commit d75b96b1 (149O.1H.1): exactly one file, src/pcae/core/human_approval_trusted_provenance.py, changed, zero UNRELATED hunks -- all classified as CONSTRUCTOR_HARDENING, TIMESTAMP_VALIDATION/TIMESTAMP_DOMAIN, SHARED_STRUCTURAL_VALIDATOR, or PARSER_VALIDATOR_UNIFICATION. B-149O.1H-1 (timestamp canonicalization injectivity): the historical defect was independently reproduced against the unmodified pre-repair source via a git worktree at 01c7fb74 -- issued_at values .0001Z and .0009Z both parsed, canonicalized to identical bytes, and produced identical digests. Against current source, both are now rejected. The full declared accepted domain was independently swept: a boundary matrix over microseconds {0,1,100,999,1000,1001,999000,999001,999999} matched the expected accept/reject pattern exactly (millisecond-grained: microsecond % 1000 == 0); a 300-instant independently-generated injectivity sweep across 2020-2035 found zero canonical-string collisions among distinct instants; timezone-offset equivalence (Z / +00:00 / +01:00 / -05:00 representations of the same instant) collapsed correctly to identical canonical strings; offset+millisecond combination and 6 classes of malformed/negative input were independently probed and behaved as expected. On this basis, the ORIGINALLY-REPORTED millisecond-level collision and its full declared accepted domain are INDEPENDENTLY CONFIRMED CLOSED. A narrower, independently NEW defect was discovered and is NOT a regression of the closed finding: _require_issued_at's injectivity gate reads datetime.microsecond, which CPython's datetime.fromisoformat silently truncates (drops, does not reject) for any raw ISO-8601 fractional-second string longer than six digits. Two distinct raw issued_at strings differing only beyond the sixth fractional digit (e.g. .0000001Z vs .0000009Z) both parse successfully and canonicalize identically -- reproduced directly, confirmed byte-identical canonical payloads and identical SHA-256 digests. This is the same class of defect B-149O.1H-1 closed, one precision level deeper than the 149O.1H.1 boundary matrix's own 0..999999-microsecond (six-fractional-digit) sweep. Recorded as BLOCKING per the literal governing-verification-rule condition 'accepted semantically distinct timestamps canonicalize identically', though of narrow practical severity (requires an adversarial proof author to hand-craft 7+ fractional digits; no realistic clock source in this stack emits sub-microsecond ISO-8601 precision). B-149O.1H-1 is therefore REOPENED on this narrow basis only -- the original collision pair and domain remain independently confirmed closed. B-149O.1H-2 (public constructor / parser domain equivalence): the historical defect was independently reproduced against the pre-repair source -- direct construction with proof_version=True, an invalid repository_id, and an Ag3OperationReference with an empty job_id / malformed commit SHA all succeeded with no exception. Against current source, the shared validator architecture (_require_proof_version, _require_nonempty_str, _require_sha256_hex, _require_commit_sha, _require_repository_instance_id, _require_rollback_site, _require_issued_at) was independently identified and traced: all seven are called by both the parser path (_build_proof_from_document) and every constructor path (HumanApprovalProvenanceProof.__post_init__, Ag3OperationReference.__post_init__, Ag5OperationReference.__post_init__) -- one shared layer, not two drifting ones. 21 independent adversarial direct-construction probes were run (proof_version type/bool/range matrix: True, False, 0, 2, -1, '1', 1.0, None, [], {} -- 10/10 rejected, only integer 1 accepted and confirmed type is int not bool; invalid repository_id, invalid decision_record_digest, invalid binding_digest, 5 empty required identifiers, malformed issued_at, sub-millisecond issued_at, AG3/AG5 family mismatch both directions, Ag3/Ag5OperationReference empty/malformed field constructions) -- 21/21 correctly rejected, 0 bypasses. Normalization equivalence independently confirmed: a direct construction given a raw 'AG3' string and a non-canonical +01:00-offset issued_at produces canonical bytes byte-identical to the equivalent parsed proof. B-149O.1H-2 is INDEPENDENTLY CONFIRMED CLOSED -- PUBLIC CONSTRUCTOR DOMAIN MATCHES STRUCTURAL PARSER DOMAIN. Model immutability re-confirmed (FrozenInstanceError on both top-level and nested operation-reference mutation attempts). F-149O.1C-1 independently re-verified: 13 self-selected-trust-field/unknown-field attacks, duplicate top-level JSON key, AG5-discriminator-with-AG3-payload, mixed AG3+AG5 fields, missing rollback_site, and unknown family 'AG7' all correctly rejected -- INDEPENDENTLY CONFIRMED IMPLEMENTED, no regression. F-149O.1C-2 unchanged, editorial debt only; requirement count remains 117 (HATP-REQ-001..117), contract confirmed byte-unchanged. Signed-payload completeness independently cross-referenced against HATP-REQ-069's field list: all 11 common fields plus family-specific AG3/AG5 pairs present; SIGNED PAYLOAD COMPLETE FOR HATP-001 WAVE-3 SECURITY SEMANTICS; no self-selected trust field constructible into the payload. Canonical JSON rule independently reconstructed (sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':') , ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False, UTF-8) and confirmed via direct source read. An independent from-scratch canonicalizer (plain json.dumps, no import of production canonicalization code) was built and used to compute AG3/AG5 golden vectors from first principles: both independently-recomputed digests are byte-for-byte identical to production's own digest_hatp_proof_payload output for the same input. The governing prompt's own quoted 'currently reported golden digests' did not match either value -- per the prompt's own explicit caveat to treat those as claims to verify and to ignore stale prompt-example digest strings, this is resolved as a stale illustrative example, not a production discrepancy. Golden vectors independently confirmed unchanged from the pre-repair (149O.1G) canonicalizer's output for already-accepted millisecond-precision input. Key-order independence, whitespace independence, and a representative Unicode round-trip (ASCII + accented + emoji + combining codepoints) all confirmed. SHA-256 verification: independently recomputed hashlib.sha256(canonical_bytes).hexdigest() matches digest_hatp_proof_payload's own output exactly. Mutation sensitivity: 12/12 independently-mutated accepted semantic fields (principal_id, signer_key_id, provider_profile, repository_id, decision_record_id, decision_record_digest, binding_id, binding_digest, rollback_site/family, issued_at at millisecond granularity, job_id, original_commit_sha) each independently change the digest; cross-family collision resistance confirmed with shared opaque values. Purity/dependency/vocabulary audit: AST import-walk confirms the module's only dependency is pcae.core.repository_identity.is_valid_repository_instance_id (itself a pure uuid.UUID format check, no I/O); no import of hatp_bootstrap, rollback_approval_evidence, permission_broker*, agent.py, or commands/agent.py; no datetime.now/time.time/open/requests/socket/os.environ/getenv call anywhere in the module source; no verification-status vocabulary (approval_present, HATP_VALID, UNKNOWN_SIGNER, VALID) defined as any public attribute or dataclass field (the module docstring deliberately discusses these names as documentation of the boundary it stays on the near side of, which is expected and correct, and was independently distinguished from an actual code-level definition). Report-trust self-hosting: this phase's own nested phase ID 149O.1H.2 was independently confirmed to round-trip correctly through the 149O.1R-repaired evidence-phase-ID extractor as its own standalone token, distinct from 149O.1H and 149O.1H.1. Files changed: tests/test_phase_149o_1h_2_hatp_proof_models_canonical_serialization_independent_reverification.py (new, 99 tests), docs/PHASE_149O_1H_2_HATP_PROOF_MODELS_CANONICAL_SERIALIZATION_INDEPENDENT_REVERIFICATION.md (new), PROJECT_STATUS.md, CHANGELOG.md, plus task-lifecycle files (opened this phase's task, closed 3 stale idle-placeholder tasks left over in tasks/active/ from the 149O.1H.1/149O.1H.1R/149O.1R lineage). Zero src/pcae/** production files, zero docs/contracts/** files, and zero of the 149O.1R report-trust surface files (phase_reports.py, commands/phase.py, commands/phase_reports.py, cli.py) were touched. Regressions: Wave-3 (test_hatp_proof_models.py + test_hatp_canonical_serialization.py + test_phase_149o_1g_...py) 100 passed; 149O.1H historical suite 166 passed; 149O.1H.1 repair suite 93 passed; combined Wave-3 359 passed; Wave-1/2 foundation (test_repository_identity.py + test_hatp_bootstrap_foundation.py + test_phase_149o_1e_...py + test_phase_149o_1f_...py + test_phase_149o_1f_1_...py) 103 passed; 149O.1F.2 90 passed; phase-report trust (test_phase_reports.py + test_phase_reports_cli.py + test_phase_report_trust_hard_fail.py + test_push_phase_report_identity_137f1.py) 201 passed; this phase's own new independent test file 99 passed; Fast Green (-m fast_green -n auto) 4531 passed, identical to the entering baseline, no regression; RAE/Permission-Broker/agent broad suite 5401 passed / 5 failed, all 5 independently confirmed as the known pre-existing B-149O-1..4-related forgery findings (already OPEN, unaffected by this verification-only phase), no new failures introduced. HATP-001 v1.0 remains byte-unchanged. Wave 1 and Wave 2 remain byte-unchanged. B-149O.1F-1 remains confirmed closed (not re-examined; no contrary evidence encountered). B-149O.1R-1 and B-149O.1R-2 remain closed. B-149O-1 through B-149O-4 remain OPEN, unaffected. HATP production remains NOT READY -- Wave 4 verification engine, signature verification, provider attestation verification, trusted-signer resolution, human-presence verification, real FIDO2/PIV providers, RAE/HATP integration, and AG3/AG5 Permission Broker wiring remain entirely unimplemented. Runtime remains Observed, maximum capability remains observe, execution availability remains unavailable. Recommended next phase: 149O.1H.3 -- HATP Sub-Microsecond Timestamp Truncation Narrow Repair, scoped as narrowly as 149O.1H.1 was to its two findings, followed by a further independent re-verification phase before Wave 4 may begin.
